# Modelling the Rental Market

## Features

- Numeric features:
    - loc_mid_lag (previous semester's average rent for meter squared)
- Categorical features:
    - zona_omi (area of the city)
    - tipologia (property type)
    - stato (property status)

## Target Variable
    - loc_mid (next semester's average rent for meter squared)

-----

## Data splitting
    - Training set: all semesters except the last one
    - Test set: last semester

## Versioning
    - after each training, a dictionary with metrics is computed
    - two directories are created: baseling with time in the name and latest with the latest model and metrics
        - inside each the model and the metrics are saved
        - additionally, also the dataset is versioned and saved in the same directory using SHA256
    - ML flow is used to track the experiments and metrics

## Modelling Approach
- the current pipeline is:
    - Missing value are set to 0
    - OrdinalEncoder transforms categorical features into numeric values (set to -1 not seen categories)
    - HistGradientBoostingRegressor is used as the model


### Model Selection
- Currently we are using HistGradientBoostingRegressor, but we can try other models in the future.

----
### Metrics
- MAE - Mean Absolute Error 
    - No sensitive to outliers
- RMSE - Root Mean Squared Error
- R2 - Coefficient of Determination
    - Measures how well the model explains the variance in the target variable
    - 1.0 means perfect prediction, 
    - 0 means the model is no better than a horizontal line (mean of the target variable)
    - negative values indicate that the model is worse than a horizontal line.
